atomicity.reason: Bundles two bounds (do not exceed the announced limit; never exceed the value) that are related facets of one power-limit obligation.
atomicity.suggestion: Split into 'shall not exceed the announced limit' and 'maximum traction power shall not exceed <value>'.

comprehensibility.reason: Readable on its own; 'the value of this requirement' refers to the need's own value field, a project convention.

feasibility.reason: 450 kW truck / 250 kW bus traction limits are realistic and implementable.

parent_fit.reason: The parent asks that the driver be told IN ADVANCE when traction power is limited; this requirement only enforces compliance with an announced limit plus a cap, it does not require the advance announcement itself.
parent_fit.suggestion: Add (or split into) a requirement that the vehicle shall announce a traction power limitation to the driver at least <t> s before it takes effect.

unambiguity.reason: The trailing 'at most the value of this requirement' attaches ambiguously: it can cap the announced limit or the delivered power directly.
unambiguity.suggestion: Rephrase: 'The traction power shall not exceed the limit announced to the driver, and never the value of this requirement.'

variant_consistency.reason: Ungated like its parent; product-specific limit sits in a variant function <<bus: 250 kW, 450 kW>> rather than in prose.

verifiability.reason: Measurable: delivered traction power <= min(announced limit, value) with a concrete kW value resolved per product (450 kW truck / 250 kW bus).
